title: Improper validation of unsafe equivalence in input could allow an attacker with high privileges to reclaim the ring…
description: CVE-2025-62620 is a medium severity vulnerability involving improper validation of unsafe equivalence in input. This flaw could allow an attacker with high privileges to reclaim the ring buffer queue status page, which may lead to loss of guest memory integrity. No known exploits are reported in the wild, and no affected versions or patches are specified.
